presets.//: The FCH (Kurdish Central) logo sits high on the outside back cover.

The Bloom badge goes at the bottom, under a hairline rule. The wrapper/anchor structure is what makes it QR-capable: at runtime BookStorage.UpdateQrCode fills in the language QR code and rewrites the href.

A default the user can overwrite, hence ifEmpty rather than always. Just the publisher name: BookData.MergeBrandingSettings sees no '©', no 'copyright' and no year here and so expands it to 'Copyright © <current year> Kurdish Central'.
CC BY 4.0, as a default the user can change.
